body:
⚔️ Zexion's RpgCraft: The Modpack

The official modpack of the YouTube series Zexion's RpgCraft.

✨ About this modpack

Zexion's RpgCraft: The Modpack is 1:1 the exact same modpack used in my YouTube series Zexion's RpgCraft.
That means you can follow along with the episodes while playing the exact same version I do — nothing more, nothing less.

Whether you just want to experience what you see on YouTube or create your own epic adventure, this is precisely the same pack from the series.

⚔️ Key Features

🎭 RPG Classes & Skills → Play as Wizards, Rogues, Paladins, Archers, Witchers, and more.

🧙 Magic & Abilities → Use spells, runes, and elemental powers.

🏹 Improved Combat → Smooth melee, ranged combat, and dodge rolls.

🗺️ Exploration & Structures → Discover new dungeons, villages, and adventures.

💎 Progression → Mythic Metals, Jewelry, and RPG attributes for deeper gameplay.

🚀 Performance Mods → Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore and others keep everything running smoothly.

🎮 YouTube Series

This modpack was specifically built for my YouTube series Zexion's RpgCraft.
👉 Want the exact same experience as in the series? This is the modpack you need!
